subject: pathology
title: Cervical and uterine pathology: HPV, carcinoma and leiomyoma

steps.tx: **HPV** (16 and 18 high risk, **E6 degrading p53 with E7 binding Rb**) drives cervical carcinogenesis through **CIN** grades; **Bethesda reporting** sorts smears (ASCUS, LSIL favouring observation, HSIL colposcoping with biopsy). Screening runs Pap plus **HPV DNA** (primary over 30, cotesting intervals) with VIA in low resource settings; **HPV vaccine** (L1 virus like particles, pre exposure adolescents, Gardasil 9 covering 16 and 18 plus warts) prevents. Smoking and immunosuppression persist lesions; condoms halve transmission.
steps.say: E6 kills p53, E7 blocks Rb: HPV 16 and 18 transform. HSIL colposcopes; vaccine pre exposure prevents.

steps.tx: **Cervical carcinoma** (squamous commonest, adenocarcinoma rising, postcoital bleeding with foul discharge) is staged **clinically by FIGO** (exam under anaesthesia with cystoscopy and proctoscopy, nodes by imaging); microinvasive IA1 cones while IB1 to IIA operate (**radical hysterectomy** with node dissection) and IIB onward gets **concurrent chemoradiation** (cisplatin). Parametrial involvement vetoes surgery; fistulas complicate advanced disease. Follow up vault smears catch recurrence.
steps.say: Postcoital bleeding is cervical until colposcopy rules out. FIGO stages clinically: early operates, late radiates with cisplatin.

steps.tx: **Endometrial hyperplasia** (unopposed estrogen: obesity, PCOS, tamoxifen; atypical hyperplasia premalignant needing hysterectomy) precedes **endometrioid carcinoma** (PTEN loss, postmenopausal bleeding, early stage cured by hysterectomy with node mapping). **Serous carcinoma** (p53, atrophic background, peritoneal spread like ovarian) behaves worse; clear cell and carcinosarcoma follow. Workup is transvaginal thickness with **pipelle biopsy**; Lynch families screen young. Progestins temporise poor surgical candidates.
steps.say: Postmenopausal bleed is endometrial until pipelle rules out. Atypical hyperplasia hysterectomises; serous p53 spreads.

steps.tx: **Leiomyoma** (benign smooth muscle whorls, reproductive age, menorrhagia with pressure, malignant transformation vanishingly rare) is managed by GnRH analogues, myomectomy (fertility) or hysterectomy; **leiomyosarcoma** (rapid growth postmenopause, necrosis with atypia and mitoses) needs hysterectomy with staging. **Adenomyosis** (endometrium in myometrium, boggy tender uterus with dysmenorrhoea) differs from **endometriosis** (ectopic glands with stroma, **chocolate cysts**, infertility, laparoscopy with hormonal suppression). Fibroids spare LDH while sarcomas raise it.
steps.say: Boggy tender dysmenorrhoeic uterus is adenomyosis. Chocolate cysts with infertility are endometriosis.
